## ALDRIC — Area Two

<!-- key: scene:area_two.tscn:Actors/Aldric -->

<sub>game/areas/area_two.tscn · `Actors/Aldric`</sub>

### display_name

ALDRIC

### dialogue_line

<!-- speaker: Aldric -->

Another one. Put the scroll away, lad, I'm no wild thing. Aldric of the Order, champion of the ninth watch.

I came down that same stair thirty years ago carrying the same rite you are carrying, and I got as far as the door at the bottom and found I did not have it in me.

So I stayed, and I made myself useful, and we have been keeping things ready for whoever came next. Come on.

---

## THE BELLKEEPER — Area Two

<!-- key: scene:area_two.tscn:Actors/Bellkeeper -->

<sub>game/areas/area_two.tscn · `Actors/Bellkeeper`</sub>

### display_name

THE BELLKEEPER

### dialogue_line

<!-- speaker: The Bellkeeper -->

Rest, and let me see to your Oathbound. You heard the bells, didn't you. I ring them, by hand, every time the sleep thins, because someone has to call you people down.

And when I am not on the rope I am holding the inside of that door, because things in these halls, not one of them should ever reach the outside world.

---

## THE ARCHIVIST — Area Two

<!-- key: scene:area_two.tscn:Actors/Archivist -->

<sub>game/areas/area_two.tscn · `Actors/Archivist`</sub>

### display_name

THE ARCHIVIST

### dialogue_line

<!-- speaker: The Archivist -->

I have recorded everyone that have came down this path, holding an oath of their own. I witness their bravery, fear and courage.

Most of all I witness heroism in each and everyone of them. The people that came and the people stayed behind, it takes a great deal of it for either choice.

---

## THE GRAVEWRIGHT — Area Two

<!-- key: scene:area_two.tscn:Actors/Gravewright -->

<sub>game/areas/area_two.tscn · `Actors/Gravewright`</sub>

### display_name

THE GRAVEWRIGHT

### dialogue_line

<!-- speaker: The Gravewright -->

Mind where you tread. They are all champions, every one of these. I dig for the ones who make it this far and no further, and I take the seal-iron off them so it can go home even when they can't.

They should not be left lying in his halls.

---

## THE NURSE — Area Two

<!-- key: scene:area_two.tscn:Actors/Nurse -->

<sub>game/areas/area_two.tscn · `Actors/Nurse`</sub>

### display_name

THE NURSE

### dialogue_line

<!-- speaker: The Nurse -->

A king asked the god of the dead for more than a man may have, and the world has been paying the bill ever since, and the bill comes due every few decades and somebody has to go and pay it.

That is all of it. What I care about is that you go up that road fed, rested.

---

## Kingsworn — Area Two

<!-- key: scene:area_two.tscn:Actors/Kingsworn -->

<sub>game/areas/area_two.tscn · `Actors/Kingsworn`</sub>

### challenge_line

<!-- speaker: The Kingsworn -->

Far enough. I know what you are; one comes every few winters now, and each of you is younger than the last.

My brother keeps the door above. I keep this one.

He may have abandoned our king but. I did not, because my oath was held, through all of it, and it holds now still.

If you wish to harm him best me as others have done before.

### sealed_line

A knight in gold-white fire stands between you and the stair down, unmoving. He does not draw. Not yet, he says.

You have not seen what this oath means yet.

Go and be told first. Then come back and mean it.

### victory_line

<!-- speaker: The Kingsworn -->

Ah. Held, and still not enough. He lowers his sword and steps off the stair, and the blue fire on him gutters low.

Go down, then. He is through there, on the seat, where he has been since the hour he unmade us.

Tell him his knight kept faith. He will not care. He never did, but I shall do it again at his next awakening as well

---

## THE QUARTERMASTER — Area Two

<!-- key: scene:area_two.tscn:Actors/Quartermaster -->

<sub>game/areas/area_two.tscn · `Actors/Quartermaster`</sub>

### display_name

THE QUARTERMASTER

### dialogue_line

<!-- speaker: The Quartermaster -->

 Coin is coin, even down here. I buy off the ones who come back and sell to the ones going on, and I have stopped asking which of you is which. Take the salve. Take two.

### shop_title

Deepmarket Stall

---

## THE SEALWRIGHT — Area Two

<!-- key: scene:area_two.tscn:Actors/Sealwright -->

<sub>game/areas/area_two.tscn · `Actors/Sealwright`</sub>

### display_name

THE SEALWRIGHT

### dialogue_line

<!-- speaker: The Sealwright -->

Scrolls, cut down here, from the seal-iron the Gravewright brings up. They hold as well as anything your Order prints upstairs, and they cost less, because there is nobody left to pay.

### shop_title

Sealwright's Bench

---

## THE LAMPLIGHTER — Area Two

<!-- key: scene:area_two.tscn:Actors/Lamplighter -->

<sub>game/areas/area_two.tscn · `Actors/Lamplighter`</sub>

### display_name

THE LAMPLIGHTER

### dialogue_line

<!-- speaker: The Lamplighter -->

 Sit down by the fire. There is a bed behind the crates and it is nobody's tonight. I keep the flames going on this stretch, and I put the champions back together before they go up that hall.

 Most of them come back down it on a board. You will not, if you sleep first.

## ToAreaThree — Area Two

<!-- key: scene:area_two.tscn:Exits/ToAreaThree -->

<sub>game/areas/area_two.tscn · `Exits/ToAreaThree`</sub>

### locked_line

The stair down is a black throat in the wall, and the Kingsworn is standing in it. Not while I hold this door, he says.

### unreported_line

The Kingsworn has stepped aside, and the stair is a black throat with nothing in it.

Aldric is still sitting where he sat down. Go and tell him. He will send you down himself as he has done countless times before.

### signpost_text

DOWN TO THE DEAD CITY
